newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS SEES EPS DILUTION FROM INSURER MERGER.
newsitem.headline: CS SEES EPS DILUTION FROM INSURER MERGER.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group said that it expected a temporary dilution of its earnings per share from a planned merger with Swiss insurer Winterthur Group.

In a joint statement to announce their plans to merge, pending shareholder approval, they said that both CS and Winterthur shareholders would benefit financially from creating the new financial group.
"These benefits will offset initial dilution of Credit Suisse Group's earnings per share," they said.

"The combined company will have a stronger capital base, a more balanced revenue mix and greater growth potential, and will therefore be better positioned to capitalise on developing trends in financial services."
